run_model_evaluation: run a HuggingFace causal LM to evaluate multiple choice accuracy on the AI2 ARC dataset subjects
eval_subject_accuracy: evaluate a single subject by computing per-question logits and softmax probabilities over choices A through D
gen_prompt_fewshot: generate a few-shot prompt from a training DataFrame with k examples for a given subject
format_example_prompt: format a single row from a DataFrame into a multiple choice question prompt with optional answer
format_subject_name: format an underscore-separated subject string into a human-readable spaced subject name
